title: The test card's rows on their words

aliases.name: The test card, rows anchored to spoken words

members.role: the procedure table lands as a card, empty, before the enumeration is spoken
the first row types itself on its own spoken phrase (the row's `delay_anchor`)
the next row types on the next numbered clause and its answer cell takes the marker sweep

does: An enumerated test lands as a card and fills itself one row per numbered clause, each row waiting for its own spoken phrase - the window runs to 10 s because the last row waits that long.
